parameters.query:
WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT
    mt.id AS mission_task_id,
    m.mission_key
  FROM governance.mission_tasks mt
  JOIN governance.missions m ON m.id = mt.mission_id
  JOIN governance.repositories r ON r.id = mt.repo_id
  WHERE r.repo_key = '{{$json.repo_key_sql}}'
    AND (
      mt.status = 'pending'
      OR (mt.status = 'in_progress' AND mt.started_at < now() - interval '15 minutes')
    )
  ORDER BY mt.created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
), locked AS (
  UPDATE governance.mission_tasks mt
  SET
    status = 'in_progress',
    assigned_agent = '{{$json.agent_id_sql}}',
    started_at = now()
  FROM candidate c
  WHERE mt.id = c.mission_task_id
    AND (
      mt.status = 'pending'
      OR (mt.status = 'in_progress' AND mt.started_at < now() - interval '15 minutes')
    )
  RETURNING mt.id, mt.repo_id, c.mission_key
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM locked) THEN 'assigned' ELSE 'no_work' END AS status,
  (SELECT mission_key FROM locked LIMIT 1) AS mission_key,
  '{{$json.repo_key_sql}}' AS repo_key,
  '{{$json.agent_id_sql}}' AS agent_id,
  900 AS lock_ttl_seconds,
  to_char((now() + interval '15 minutes') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS lock_expires_at_utc,
  NULL::text AS instructions,
  'govhub-n8n'::text AS source;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'assigned', mission_key: $json.mission_key, repo_key: $json.repo_key, agent_id: $json.agent_id, lock_ttl_seconds: Number($json.lock_ttl_seconds || 900), lock_expires_at_utc: $json.lock_expires_at_utc, instructions: $json.instructions ?? null, source: $json.source || 'govhub-n8n' } }}
